s1.syndrome_frame: febrile illness with abdominal pain, rash, and conjunctivitis
key_facts: parents had mild upper respiratory symptoms for 1 week
outpatient oral antibiotics and IV fluids did not improve symptoms
admitted to surgery with suspected appendicitis
grade II/VI murmur at the left sternal border
liver and renal function tests were normal
urinalysis and urine culture were negative
high-resolution chest CT scan was not indicative of COVID-19
reverse transcription PCR for SARS-CoV-2 and blood cultures were negative

shortlist.label: Kawasaki disease
shortlist.why_kept: matches febrile illness with abdominal pain, rash, and conjunctivitis, and specific clinical findings like strawberry tongue and erythema multiforme-type rash

shortlist.label: Henoch-Schönlein purpura
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with abdominal pain, rash, and elevated inflammatory markers

shortlist.label: Stevens-Johnson syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: considered due to presence of rash, conjunctivitis, and mucosal involvement

shortlist.label: Systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: possible given fever, rash, and elevated inflammatory markers

shortlist.label: Scarlet fever
shortlist.why_kept: matches some clinical features like fever, rash, and strawberry tongue

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including fever, bilateral nonpurulent conjunctivitis, erythematous throat, palmar erythema, strawberry tongue, and erythema multiforme-type rash, are consistent with Kawasaki disease. The elevated ESR and CRP levels also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Henoch-Schönlein purpura
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not include the characteristic purpura of Henoch-Schönlein purpura

rejected.label: Stevens-Johnson syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not include the characteristic mucosal involvement and skin detachment of Stevens-Johnson syndrome

rejected.label: Systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not include the characteristic joint involvement of systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis

rejected.label: Scarlet fever
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not include the characteristic sandpapery rash of scarlet fever
